svg.title: Graph Memory evidence-first pipeline
svg.desc: A question passes through intent, then hybrid BM25 and Qdrant recall. Qdrant candidates resolve to canonical ArangoDB records and graph evidence. An evidence gate chooses answer, clarify, or scan fresh, while unsupported requests can deflect before recall.

g.text: Intent routes. Hybrid recall finds. Evidence decides.

g.aria-label: Canonical record and graph evidence stage

g.text: A semantic match is a lead—not proof.
